reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp for ten years, and connecting third-party software to our Google Drive feels like handing over access to all our confidential client records. Until I am completely certain that an external tool cannot read or touch our existing firm folders, I will not pay for a subscription.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: An independent security verification or live proof showing Docketra cannot access any of our existing private Google Drive folders.
